page: Amazon Web Services trn1.32xlarge is an accelerated computing server instance managed under the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The platform features an Intel Xeon 8375C x86_64 processor operating at 3.5 GHz, delivering 64 physical cores across 128 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading. It incorporates 54 MB of L3 cache, along with AVX-512 vector instruction extensions and hardware cryptographic support. System host memory totals 512.0 GB of DDR4 clocked at 3 GHz, balancing out to 4.0 GB per physical core. Accelerator hardware consists of 16 AWS Trainium chips delivering a cumulative 512 GB of GPU VRAM. Storage consists of 7,600 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD, alongside a high-throughput network interface rated at an 800 Gbps baseline.

Benchmark measurements indicate extreme throughput across multi-threaded operations and massive parallel workloads. The PassMark CPU test reached a top-tier score of 86,301.41, with corresponding top-tier results in extended instructions (104,866.52) and CPU encryption (109,511.98). Stress-ng multi-core reached 123,833.48 and Geekbench multi-core hit 16,220.0, both within the top 25% of tested servers. Memory bandwidth scales strongly under large-block transfers, reaching 334.77 GB/sec read and 135.55 GB/sec write. In contrast, single-threaded processing reflects standard x86 performance, with a single-core Geekbench score of 1,685.0 and stress-ng score of 1,893.4 settling within the median tier.

On targeted application benchmarks, the instance recorded 103.85 million operations per second on Redis SET evaluations and 69.41 GB/sec in static web serving. LLM inference results show strong prompt processing performance on 135M models (2,985.55 tokens/sec) and 7B models (189.43 tokens/sec). However, generative token generation is comparatively resource-constrained on larger models, registering 2.78 tokens/sec on 70B architectures.

Given the density of 16 AWS Trainium accelerators, high-speed 800 Gbps interconnect, and large NVMe capacity, the trn1.32xlarge provides high compute density per server footprint. It is tailored specifically for distributed deep learning model training, large-scale matrix operations, and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services trn1.32xlarge is an accelerated computing instance engineered around 16 AWS Trainium accelerators with 512 GB of dedicated accelerator memory. Host compute is provided by a 64-core, 128-thread Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz on the Nitro hypervisor, supported by 512 GB of DDR4 system RAM. High-performance I/O subsystems include 7,600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and an 800 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark metrics highlight exceptional multi-core throughput, top-tier cryptographic execution, and strong large-block memory bandwidth, alongside elevated prompt processing speeds in LLM workflows. However, large model text generation shows moderate token rates. The trn1.32xlarge is architected for distributed machine learning training, deep neural network development, and large-scale parallel processing workloads.
